text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin fully enjoyed the fierce battle 
with her rival in the "Takarazuka Kinen." 
The wind felt so good that she wished she 
could run even more—

"...Seeing Mejiro Ryan bow to the 
audience, she flusteredly conveys her 
gratitude to those who cheered for her. 
Holding a vow in her heart to keep 
answering their voices from now on."

Ines Fujin wants to bring joy to the 
people cheering for her in her next race 
as well.

What the fans truly desire is undoubtedly 
to see her enjoying her races. The Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) seems like the perfect place 
for her to have fun to her heart's 
content!
